I answered Pree in a thread under their message in #central-team: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

The source is Pree's own message in #central-team on Jun 9. They wrote that Pine Crossing's morning receiver could only see the afternoon shift on the appointment screen, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 got logged on a sticky note.

That message names the store but gives no site ID or address. I couldn't find either anywhere Pree can see, and no account files are visible to them. I told Pree that and suggested checking the rollout tracker or asking store ops if the account sheet needs more than the name.
